title: יוסי בן יוחנן

paragraphs: Yose ben Yochanan of Jerusalem, Mishnah, Avot, chapter 1: head of the court and colleague of Yose ben Yoezer the Nasi. He was not a priest. In Maimonides, chapter 7, it is a scribal error to write ‘Yose ben Yoezer, Yose ben Yochanan the high priest.’ It should read ‘Yose ben Yochanan, and likewise Yochanan the high priest.’ The scribe skipped from one Yochanan to the other. Ein Doreshin 16a has Yosef ben Yochanan; in the Mishnah, mishnah 2, Yose. There is also Abba Yose ben Yochanan; see above. When he died, the clusters ceased: Sotah 9:9 (Bavli, Sotah 47).
